headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • CESC reported standalone revenue of ~Rs2880cr (+5.6% yoy) in Q2FY27, aided by unit sales of 3,468 MU (+7% yoy). • Renewable plans remain ambitious, with 0.4 GWp operational as of September 2026, and another 3.1 GWp of organic capacity additions planned through FY30E.

Negatives: • CESC continues to see modest growth in its standalone business. • Earnings were also impacted by higher losses across the distribution franchisees, particularly at Malegaon. • T&D losses at distribution franchisees are on a downward trajectory. • Combined PAT losses from Rajasthan circles and Malegaon stood at (-) Rs36 cr from (-) Rs31 cr in Q2FY26.
